_help: Paste each approved key marketplace's tracking link template between the quotes. Write {url} where the store page address goes, for example https://example-network.com/click?id=YOURID&u={url} . Stores that CheapShark tracks (Steam, Epic, GOG, Fanatical, Humble, Green Man Gaming and the rest) can't go here: CheapShark requires its own redirect for them. Never put passwords or API secrets in this file, it is public.
